raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Program (Home, Light Activity)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Postpartum return to light training with gradual load where cleared"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Light Mobilization & Walk"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_chest_push 1x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Pelvis & Core Start"
        warmup:
          marching 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_floor_engagement 2x6..10 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 30m "Lower Body Gentle"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squat 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walking + Gentle Upper"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 2x6..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core Activation"
        warmup:
          marching 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 2x8..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 30m "Glute & Hamstring (Light)"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lying_leg_raise 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Cardio Emphasis + Light Resistance"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chair_dips 2x6..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotations 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Core & Pelvic Floor"
        warmup:
          marching 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          side_plank 2x15s..30s rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 35m "Lower Body Prep"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Gentle Push Pattern"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x6..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Core Stability"
        warmup:
          marching 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 2x8..12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spine_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 35m "Lower Body End Phase 4"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Light Weights Introduction"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 2x6..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Pelvic Floor Focus"
        warmup:
          march_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_floor_engagement 3x6..10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 40m "Lower Body Strength"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_ciss 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Push Pattern Progression"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x6..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Core Stability Progression"
        warmup:
          march_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          side_plank 3x20s rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 40m "Glute & Hamstring"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Return to Gentle Training"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 2x6..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Core & Stability"
        warmup:
          marching 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          plank 2x15s..30s rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Total Body Light"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Moderate Load"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Posterior Chain"
        warmup:
          march_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Accessory"
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_crossover 60 seconds

EXERCISE VOCABULARY: (as listed)
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Notes:
- This plan starts with very light activity suitable for 4 weeks post-cesarean, focusing on pelvic floor engagement, gentle core activation, and gradual reintroduction of resistance with safe movements. 
- Abdominal and core training is progressed carefully; avoid high abdominal strain. 
- If any activity causes discomfort, stop and consult. 
- All sessions assume home environment with a yoga mat; no equipment beyond light dumbbells as cleared.
